issues.finding: An audit query limited to 20 records can omit inference rows from a multi-turn tool run.
issues.acceptance: Retrieve complete audit coverage or use a unique request/session correlation for every inference; no missing rows claimed as passed.

issues.finding: An exception discarded partial per-turn provider evidence; exit-status retrieval after reaping could incorrectly display 0, and early CLI exit was labelled as a timeout.

issues.finding: Provider identity validation hardcoded gpt-6.1-sol even for a declared diagnostic gpt-6-luna request.

issues.finding: Default-registration assertions incorrectly required Read/Ls to have unknown/zero scope although their existing canonical cwd registration is reviewed and scoped; Grep/Find default completion metadata is different.
issues.acceptance: Compare each concrete tool actual registration contract; unknown scope still requires approval and proof; preserve marker/result assertions.

issues.finding: The fixture workspace is below an ignored live/workspaces ancestor, so actual rg respects Git ignore and returns no marker match despite the marker file existing.
issues.acceptance: Use an independent nonignored fixture workspace without changing production ignore semantics; actual Grep receipt contains the literal fixture marker.

issues.finding: wait_turn interpreted residual approval text in the viewport as a current modal and then waited for a nonexistent approval. Actual edit/read/terminal completion had already happened. Further full-run checks still waited for legacy working... rather than the actual assistant progress footer.

issues.finding: A fresh run failed before process exec because child_env referenced an unassigned LivePTY.model attribute. No provider inference or UI evidence was produced.

issues.finding: Follow-up canary used lowercase nonce while the metadata pattern accepted uppercase; actual later user message/receipt existed but the label predicate failed.
issues.acceptance: Exact typed token is recognized in actual following provider request and paired Bash receipt; distinguish queue input screenshot from later transcript publication.

issues.finding: The test extended Bash sleep to the default 30s operation limit, causing a genuine tool timeout before its finish sentinel.
issues.acceptance: Keep scripted successful-task duration inside configured tool deadline; record actual start/finish interval and timeout boundary.

issues.finding: A stale running variable raised NameError after follow-up was actually submitted; Python compilation did not detect the undefined name.
issues.acceptance: Static undefined-name checks plus actual task completion; preserve the failed round.

issues.finding: A 1751-character prompt blocked in one PTY write before the old 2048-character pacing threshold; no PPT request reached the model.
issues.acceptance: Nonblocking partial writes with pumping, EAGAIN handling and bounded deadline; verify actual provider prompt delivery.

issues.finding: The long Write approval remained visually labelled review details after all visible detail ranges had been captured. The driver stopped before attempting the actual guarded decision.
issues.acceptance: Capture every 1..N detail interval; submit a real decision key and require real modal closure and matching tool receipt, never bypass TUI guards.
issues.diagnosis: 172353 raw PTY emits final details108-127/127 then [y] once 1553 bytes later before allow key. capture happened mid-redraw without draining; screenshot footer is inconclusive, not a confirmed TUI defect. Production guard accepted only after its full coverage check.

issues.finding: The PPT prompt instructed use of Python although both python and python3 are blocked by the existing Bash command policy.
issues.acceptance: Genuine model/tool generation with allowed commands; preserve policy rejection as a failed round and separately repair its lifecycle handling.

issues.finding: The driver treated a normal idle prompt after a known durable terminal Error as success, then discovered the missing PPT only during wait_file.
issues.acceptance: Inspect fresh run_terminal outcome tied to the current user turn; capture known error immediately and retain provider/receipt evidence.

issues.finding: Full-run follow-up assertions interpolated lowercase nonce although actual input/provider markers are uppercase; real queued prompt and matching receipts were present.
issues.acceptance: Compare exact submitted uppercase marker in later real request plus matching Bash receipt, rerun corrected driver.

issues.finding: Policy explanation phrase matcher missed the real answer that python3 is blacklisted and did not write the marker.
issues.acceptance: Recognize actual rejection explanation with known error/quiescence receipt and no side effect, not just an echoed nonce.

issues.finding: A 30000-byte character-by-character pressure prompt timed out after 3356 bytes due terminal redraw/backpressure, before a pressure model request.
issues.acceptance: Use existing LineEditor bracketed paste with bounded write, prove all input bytes reached actual provider and later pressure response.

issues.finding: OOXML checker did not assert the main presentation MIME content type, so it reported structural pass on a deck LibreOffice cannot load.
issues.acceptance: Canonical MIME and relationship checks followed by actual file rendering and full-size visual review.

issues.finding: Frozen184011 report labels internal nonstream summary as context-pressure-4 inference; same-request policy-error receipt explanation incorrectly required a strictly later request.
issues.acceptance: Distinct interactive nonce-bearing streams versus internal summary rows; every row retains real complete provider proof. A missing main pressure turn must fail; exact refusal receipt can be consumed in same provider request.

issues.finding: Provider evidence join allowed chronological fallback when exposed response/route IDs disagreed. Actual184011 independently matched30/30 IDs, but future wrong joins could pass.
issues.acceptance: Exact upstream response_id to usage.response_id and route.id to usage.route_id, session consistency, uniqueness; ordered fallback only absent join keys. Local capture sequence is labelled local, not upstream-returned evidence.

issues.finding: 190417 /session new acknowledged distinct physical ID and created empty named JSONL; physical_session_ids scanned row fields only and falsely omitted new session before first turn, stopping before actual fresh provider response.

productDefects.finding: Approved builtin grep in a durable interactive run returns a successful tool receipt but lacks completion attestation; run becomes unknown and the CLI exits with quiescence/publication errors. The first scoped fix did not cover empty-whitelist default registration; a clean committed real run reproduced the failure.

productDefects.sourceCommit: e0493e5fe92f98ee460a0e25740a97852272ddf2 with first-fix working changes; exact dirty source snapshot unavailable
productDefects.acceptance: Bounded configurable or appropriate production response budgets, correct durable TUI provider-error refresh, deterministic regressions and fresh actual default 6.1 runs.

productDefects.finding: A scoped real sequence with successful ls, grep and read receipts was stopped by repeated response count=3. Loop middleware compares only assistant content; tool-only responses can share empty text while requesting different operations.
productDefects.acceptance: Compare complete semantic response including tool names/arguments independent of random call IDs; retain genuine repeated-text and repeated-tool protection, bounded streams and cancellation; deterministic regressions then actual multi-tool rerun.

productDefects.finding: Real durable-mode long Bash tasks have no busy spinner/working footer; canonical tool event handling never updates legacy spinner state. Filesystem timing and real follow-up input demonstrate the task actually ran.
productDefects.acceptance: Show progress from exact canonical observed tool-start occurrences, preserve concurrent-tool progress until all matching results, reject stale/duplicate/terminal-run resurrection, clear on authoritative quiescent refresh/cancel; deterministic and actual long-task screenshot.

productDefects.finding: Esc during a non-idempotent Bash run joins its owned process group and records local-resource resolution, but operation receipt/terminal outcome remain honestly unknown. Current CLI treats the fenced unknown publication as fatal and exits before a fresh user prompt.
productDefects.acceptance: Preserve unknown receipt/run and actual resource proofs; no automatic replay/continuation. For confirmed joined resources provide explicit safe new-session recovery, keeping pending/unproven resources fenced; genuine Esc/new session/fresh prompt regression.
productDefects.deterministicEvidence: internal/cli/repl_unknown_cancel_recovery_test.go: actual prepared helper cancellation, preserved unknown receipt/terminal, fresh physical session and separate unresolved workspace marker quarantine; negative evidence and stale identity cases

productDefects.finding: A Bash command rejected by policy before process launch has no local completion proof; durable ownership reports unknown and the interactive CLI terminates with publication mismatch.
productDefects.acceptance: Trustworthy no-process completion on actual pre-launch refusal, known error terminal, no side effects and a following real turn; never infer quiescence for unknown or launched processes.

productDefects.finding: Automatic compaction after a real Write selected micro; durable core requires a typed summary projection and refused the result before the next HTTP inference. No Bash or PPTX followed.
productDefects.acceptance: Correct durable strategy selection with real typed summary projection and unchanged integrity guard; real compaction trigger, retained early fact/latest prompt and following real inference.
productDefects.diagnosis: Admission estimates include role/name/call IDs and serialized tool arguments; compaction estimates omit them and can double-count shadow Content alongside text blocks. The real Write arguments were 8392 bytes (~3044 estimated tokens). Unified incorrectly accepted micro without typed durable projection. The screen 21098 is cumulative usage, not the next request context estimate.

productDefects.finding: Real production summary completed, but placeholder-based cut left insufficient room for actual summary body: tokens_after102760 exceeded102400. Guard correctly refused projection publication; no pressure-4 main inference or recall followed.
productDefects.acceptance: Reserve bounded durable summary body plus provider user role and untrusted framing; preserve final exact budget/current input/source integrity checks. Real committed summary, subsequent user inference and exact recall must pass.
